Observed handle, descriptive and mutable.
Verified account type. Standard channel; not an Official Artist Channel in observed UI.
Account ownership population; channel_owned for these exports. Further filters still apply.
Platform daily calendar timezone; America/Los_Angeles. Dates are not shifted to UTC.
Stable capture identifier joining report_manifest.json and collection_index.csv.

current_retrieval or newly_retrieved_historical. No file is an original October20 snapshot.
Named reporting window. Distinct windows remain separate even when dates overlap.
Inclusive reporting start from Studio UI, ISO date.
Inclusive reporting end from Studio UI. Native ZIP end date is exclusive for these files.
Native Pacific calendar date for daily data. Blank for period/lifetime summary.
Content filter used for this report, or all. Distinct from verified format of a single video.
Video/Short/livestream classification from explicit source filter; channel rows retain report format.
Canonical grouping format. Video IDs use verified intrinsic format so repeated all-format and filtered exports do not double-count.
JSON of observed report filters, always part of canonical key. Empty object means no additional filter.
Dimension selected in source report. Chart checkboxes are series selection, not report filters.
Stable YouTube video key. Blank for channel and non-video dimension rows.
Source video title, descriptive only; source encoding retained.
JSON object of native dimension names/values, such as Geography or Traffic source. Do not merge different dimensions.
Normalized metric key joining metric_dictionary.csv.
Numeric value in unit column; blank when unavailable/suppressed/not applicable. Never fill blank with zero.
observed,zero,unavailable,suppressed,or not_applicable; see value_status_dictionary.csv.

Explicit normalized unit. percent_0_100 denotes percentage-point proportions such as CTR or demographic shares. percent denotes percentage points without a 100% upper bound, used for average percentage viewed because replay can exceed 100%. Neither percentage unit is a fraction.
Additive within compatible complete scope, or nonadditive. Never add overlapping reporting windows.
Unchanged native CSV header.
Original CSV cell representation. Preserved even when UI evidence makes normalized numeric value unavailable.
Relative path of unchanged extracted native CSV within this package.
Stable YouTube Studio channel analytics entrypoint. Exact dynamic report URL was not retained; filters and report context are separate columns.
Saved original native ZIP URL, if publication has completed; source bytes remain unchanged.
One-based CSV logical record number including header as row1; not physical text line for multiline cells.
table,chart_total_daily,or selected_chart_series. Default chart selection need not cover all videos.
Acquisition timestamp proxy from downloaded file LastWriteTimeUtc, not exact browser click time.
Explicit evidence basis for acquisition timestamp.
Observed downloaded file timestamp in UTC; same file-metadata proxy, not independent server retrieval time.
Source limitations such as prepublication chart padding or UI/export mismatch; no inferred correction of source bytes.
Deterministic canonical preference; full metric source preferred to redundant initial export.
Count of source observations represented by canonical row.
Semicolon-separated report IDs contributing matching canonical observations.
true when nonmissing numeric source observations disagree within one canonical key. Sources remain in observations.csv.
